name: work-queue-requests
description: CIAL's work-queue-requests starter kit for internal apps — Cloudflare Workers + Hono + Vite/React, auth, RBAC, CI/CD, and the Claude Code harness built in.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:web && npm run test:profile && npm run test:hooks && npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:core && npm run verify:needs && npm run verify:bootstrap && npm run verify:edge && npm run verify:kit-migrations && npm run verify:test-performance && npm run verify:agents && npm run verify:skills && npm run verify:deps && npm run verify:checks
scripts.db:apply:staging: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file schema.sql --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.db:apply: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file schema.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:check: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --config wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --var APP_BUILD_VERSION:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
scripts.deploy: node scripts/deployment-target.mjs --require cial && npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --var APP_BUILD_VERSION:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
